The Ostojic Group are currently seeking experienced personnel to fill a number of Welder positions in our Darwin Workshop.

The position is responsible for the construction, assembly, maintenance and repair of stationary steam boilers and boiler house auxiliaries.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Read and interpret project plans, engineering drawings, blueprints and other written instructions and diagrams to perform task at hand
Perform fabrication and repair works on various metal structures and components according to engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Work with variety of materials, including steel, aluminium, and other alloys
Weld small and large components such as copper plumbing, beams, and pipelines.
Perform appropriate type of weld - base on project needs and specifications
Weld components in flat, vertical, and overhead positions.
Ensure fabrication and repairs are carried out using the proper safety guidelines to ensure rework jobs do not occur.
Use a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Conduct quality checks on completed work to ensure it meets standard specifications
Monitor machinery for appropriate usage and temperature
Follow and enforce strict safety regulations such as wearing heat-resistant gloves, protective masks, and safety shoes to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace.

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Trade certificate in Engineering Fabrication or Equivalent
Proficient in performing all welding, gouging, cutting or other duties
Post trade experience in the same field
Proactive attitude with the desire to work reliably as part of an outstanding team to deliver excellence for our clients
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Experience working with a variety of materials, including steel, aluminum, and other alloys
Familiarity with a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Strong attention to detail and the ability to conduct quality checks on completed work
Ability to work independently or as part of a team to complete assigned tasks
Knowledge of safety procedures and regulations to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace
Strong communication and reporting skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

Mechanical Fitter/Fitter – Full-Time
Location:  Welshpool Western Australia 6106
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary: $80,000 – $110,000 per annum (depending on skills and experience)

MINPROVISE INTERNATIONALPTY LTD is a leading total solutions provider delivering specialist maintenance and shutdown services, engineering, fabrication, project services, and sustaining capital works. We also provide a comprehensive range of equipment and products, supporting the mining, oil & gas, and construction industries across Australia and internationally.

We are currently seeking experienced and motivated Fitters to join our growing team on a full-time basis.

About the Role
As a Fitter, you will be responsible for assembling, installing, maintaining, and repairing a wide range of mechanical equipment and machinery. You will work closely with engineers and maintenance teams to ensure equipment operates safely, efficiently, and in accordance with industry standards.

Key Responsibilities
•	Read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, and technical specifications.
•	Assemble, install, and commission mechanical equipment and components.
•	Carry out preventative maintenance and routine servicing of machinery.
•	Diagnose mechanical faults and perform repairs or replace defective components.
•	Use fabrication equipment and welding techniques to modify or manufacture components where required.
•	Ensure the correct alignment, calibration, and adjustment of machinery and equipment.
•	Conduct inspections and testing to ensure compliance with quality and safety standards.
•	Safely operate hand tools, power tools, and workshop machinery.
•	Maintain accurate records of maintenance, repairs, and equipment servicing.
•	Collaborate with engineers, supervisors, and other tradespeople to complete projects efficiently.
•	Assist with training apprentices and junior team members when required.
•	Follow all workplace health and safety policies and procedures.

Skills and Experience
•	Minimum 1–2 years of full-time experience as a Fitter or in a similar mechanical fitting role.
•	Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and specifications.
•	Strong troubleshooting and mechanical problem-solving skills.
•	Experience using mechanical fitting tools, workshop equipment, and fabrication machinery.
•	Strong commitment to workplace safety and quality workmanship.
•	Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
•	Excellent communication and organisational skills.

What We Offer
•	Full-time, permanent employment.
•	Competitive salary of $80,000 – $110,000 per annum.
•	Opportunities to work on major mining and industrial projects.
•	Ongoing training and career development.
•	Supportive team environment with long-term career opportunities

result.description:
A growing commercial cleaning and facilities services business is seeking an experienced Corporate Services Manager to oversee business operations, service delivery, client relationships and portfolio performance across South Australia, Victoria and Western Australia.

This is a senior management position suited to someone with strong experience in commercial cleaning, facilities services, multi-site operations, client relationship management, workforce leadership and operational performance.

The successful candidate will work closely with the executive leadership team to ensure operational standards, labour performance, compliance, client satisfaction and business growth objectives are achieved.

About the Role

The Corporate Services Manager will be responsible for planning, coordinating and improving the administrative, operational and commercial functions of an allocated portfolio.

The role will involve oversight of service delivery, client relationships, staffing, performance management, compliance systems, reporting, audits, business improvement and portfolio development opportunities.

This role requires a hands-on leader who can manage competing priorities, support Area Managers and site teams, maintain strong client relationships and contribute to the continued growth and professionalism of the business.

Key Responsibilities

Responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

Oversee the administration and operational performance of cleaning and facilities services across the allocated portfolio.
Work with the executive leadership team to support business planning, portfolio performance and strategic objectives.
Monitor labour-to-sales performance, roster structures, site profitability and operational results.
Manage client relationships and act as a senior escalation point for service delivery matters.
Identify opportunities for account growth, additional works, recharges, tender opportunities and new business leads.
Support tendering, quoting and commercial submissions where required.
Lead, support and performance manage Area Managers, Supervisors and cleaning teams.
Ensure appropriate staffing, training, succession planning and workforce coverage across the portfolio.
Monitor compliance with company systems, operational procedures, WHS requirements, audits, toolbox talks and site documentation.
Ensure cleaning standards, site presentation and service quality meet company and client expectations.
Support injury management and return-to-work processes in line with company HR and WHS protocols.
Review site performance data, audit outcomes, customer feedback and operational risks.
Implement process improvements to strengthen consistency, productivity and service delivery.
Represent the business professionally in client meetings, operational reviews and portfolio development activities.
Skills and Experience Required

The successful candidate will ideally have:

Previous experience in a senior operations, corporate services, facilities management or commercial cleaning management role.
Strong experience managing multi-site service delivery teams.
Demonstrated ability to manage client relationships and resolve operational issues quickly and professionally.
Experience with labour management, rostering, cost control and performance reporting.
Understanding of WHS, compliance, audits and quality standards in a service-based environment.
Ability to lead managers, supervisors and frontline employees across multiple locations.
Strong communication, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
Commercial awareness, including the ability to identify growth, quoting and additional service opportunities.
Strong computer literacy and ability to use business systems, reporting tools and operational platforms.
Current driver licence and willingness to travel as required across the allocated portfolio.
Qualifications

Relevant qualifications in business, management, operations, facilities management or a related field will be highly regarded.

Equivalent industry experience in commercial cleaning, facilities services, multi-site operations or service-based management will also be considered.

What We Offer
Senior full-time management role with a growing service-based business.
Salary range of $115,000 - $135,000 per annum plus superannuation.
Company vehicle and fuel card.
Laptop and mobile phone.
Opportunity to work closely with the executive leadership team.
Broad portfolio responsibility across SA, VIC and WA.
Long-term opportunity to contribute to business growth, service improvement and operational excellence.
How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a short cover letter outlining your experience in corporate services, facilities services, commercial cleaning operations, client management and team leadership.

We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage applications from suitably qualified candidates with the right skills, experience and work rights for the role.

result.description:
Rigger – Full-Time
Location: Welshpool, Western Australia 6106
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary: $80,000 – $110,000 per annum (depending on skills and experience)

MINPROVISE INTERNATIONAL PTY LTD is a leading total solutions provider delivering specialist maintenance and shutdown services, engineering, fabrication, project services, and sustaining capital works. We also provide a comprehensive range of equipment and products, supporting the mining, oil & gas, and construction industries across Australia and internationally.

We are currently seeking experienced and motivated Riggers to join our growing team on a full-time basis.

About the Role
As a Rigger, you will be responsible for planning, preparing, and performing rigging operations to safely lift, move, position, and secure heavy machinery, structural steel, equipment, and materials across mining, oil & gas, construction, and industrial projects. You will work closely with crane operators, engineers, supervisors, and other trades to ensure lifting activities are carried out safely and efficiently in accordance with Australian Standards and site requirements.

Key Responsibilities
•	Read and interpret lifting plans, engineering drawings, and work instructions.
•	Plan and perform rigging operations for lifting, positioning, and installation of heavy equipment and structural components.
•	Select, inspect, and safely use lifting gear, including slings, chains, wire ropes, shackles, spreader bars, lifting beams, and hoists.
•	Direct crane operators using standard hand signals and radio communications during lifting operations.
•	Assemble, dismantle, align, and secure heavy machinery, plant, structural steel, and industrial equipment.
•	Conduct pre-start inspections of rigging equipment and ensure all lifting gear is certified and fit for use.
•	Identify hazards, assess lifting risks, and implement appropriate control measures.
•	Assist with shutdowns, maintenance projects, equipment installations, and major construction activities.
•	Maintain accurate records of lifting equipment inspections and completed work where required.
•	Work collaboratively with supervisors, engineers, crane operators, and other trades to ensure projects are completed safely and on schedule.
•	Follow all workplace health and safety policies, procedures, and environmental requirements.

Skills and Experience
•	Minimum 1–2 years of full-time experience as a Rigger in mining, construction, or heavy industrial environments.
•	Current High Risk Work Licence – Rigging (Basic, Intermediate, or Advanced).
•	Strong knowledge of lifting techniques, rigging equipment, and safe lifting practices.
•	Ability to read and interpret lifting plans, engineering drawings, and technical specifications.
•	Experience working with cranes, heavy equipment, structural steel, and mechanical installations.
•	Strong commitment to workplace safety and compliance with Australian Standards.
•	Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
•	Excellent communication, problem-solving, and organisational skills.

What We Offer
•	Full-time, permanent employment.
•	Competitive salary of $80,000 – $110,000 per annum.
•	Opportunities to work on major mining, shutdown, and industrial projects.
•	Ongoing training and career development.
•	Supportive team environment with long-term career opportunities.

Duties 

Financial Reporting 

- Prepare and review month-end/quarter-end journals under all relevant accounting bases, ensuring process integrity and continuous improvement. 

- Prepare and oversee monthly Balance Sheet reconciliations, ensuring the general ledger is accurately maintained and all interfacing systems are correctly posted. 

- Consolidate financial results and report accurately to Group Finance. 

Support the preparation of accurate and comprehensive annual statutory financial statements, as well as regulatory and tax returns, in alignment with the December year-end reporting cycle. 

- Monitor developments in accounting standards and regulatory requirements, assess their impact on financial reporting and implement necessary changes. 

- Oversee tax-related filings in collaboration with tax advisors. 

- Provide technical support and advice on accounting treatments. 

- Maintain efficient, systematic filing and documentation processes. 

- Drive process optimization and technology adoption for greater efficiency. 

Audit & Compliance 

- Plan and coordinate audit processes to ensure timely regulatory reporting. 

- Liaise with internal and external auditors, ensuring compliance with accounting and financial regulations. 

- Maintain and implement internal controls to safeguard assets and ensure accurate reporting. 

Business Support & projects 

- Contribute to Back Office transformation project, Project Unify, supporting process improvement and system integration efforts

- Manage and participate in ad-hoc projects and cross-functional initiatives.

- Collaborate with other departments to align financial processes with business objectives.

- Mentor and guide junior accounting staff, fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

Qualifications & Experience

- Professional accounting designation (CPA/ACCA or equivalent).

- Minimum of 3 years’ post-qualification experience in accounting, financial reporting and analysis.

- Excellent analytical, problem-solving and technical accounting skills.

- Excellent time management skills, with the flexibility and efficiency to collaborate across multiple time zones and global teams.

- Proactive, adaptable individual with strong leadership, and process evaluation abilities, with a holistic view to technology integration and automation

- Strong proficiency in general ledger systems, BI tools, and enterprise finance applications (e.g., SAP AFO, PeopleSoft, Oracle).

- Deep understanding of various accounting frameworks, including IFRS and US GAAP. Experience working in multi-jurisdictional environments is a plus.

- Experience & good understanding of reinsurance/insurance accounting and knowledge of actuarial concepts is ideal, but not necessary.

- Strong interpersonal/negotiation skills with the ability to build relationships with different functional areas and work effectively within a team environment.

- Proven ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, deadline driven environment.

Background 

The Senior Financial Accountant, Financial Reporting role sits within our Pacific Life Re (PL Re) Financial Reporting and Tax team, reporting directly to the Manager, Financial Reporting. The role will be based in Australia and will include hybrid working arrangement (up to 4 days a week in office). 
 
The role supports the Financial Reporting team in delivering external reporting requirements across multiple bases of reporting including US GAAP, IFRS, regulatory reporting across various jurisdictions and internal Economic Capital Base.
 
The role is responsible for the preparation, analysis and delivery of financial reports on multiple accounting frameworks (e.g. US GAAP, IFRS and multiple local regulatory/internal bases as required). The role involves close collaboration with Financial Reporting and Tax, Financial Management and Treasury, Actuarial, Operations and other teams within PL Re and its parent company, Pacific Life (PL). 
 
The role is pivotal in month-end and quarter-end processes, annual statutory financial statement preparation, and ensuring compliance with statutory, regulatory, and technical accounting standards in the insurance industry. The position also encompasses tax compliance, accounting analysis, and audit support.
 
This role serves as a key contributor to the financial and regulatory reporting and supporting finance-related project activities as required.
